title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Road
description:
The three backgrounds seen in Qubasa Road, from Ganbare Goemon 4.

Includes a fancy HDMA gradient, which is meant to be inserted with UberASM tool.

Layer 3 moons are also included. Please use it with Kevin's Ram Toggled Status Bar or any other patch / uberasm that removes the status bar.

Includes three different variants seen through the original game. Pick the one you like the most.
